name: baseline
notes: Initial baseline with byt5-small, 10 epochs, greedy decoding for eval

name: longer_30ep_beams4
notes: 30 epochs with beam search eval (num_beams=4). Loss plateaued ~epoch 20 then increased (overfitting). Added use_cache, adaptive beams optimizations.

name: byt5_base_30ep
notes: Larger byt5-base model. Training loss continued decreasing through all 30 epochs (2.17 final). Significant improvement in chrF++ (14.46 vs 6.55). Best result so far.

name: byt5_large_regularized
notes: Tried byt5-large with competitor config (Adafactor, label smoothing, weight decay). Training loss stuck at ~5.6 throughout 20 epochs - model did not converge. Significantly worse than byt5-base. Possible causes: LR too high for fine-tuning, Adafactor issues, or need warmup/different schedule.
